correctness.rationale: The finite-field Paley graph has 25 vertices, adjacency by nonzero-square difference, and clique face counts (25,150,250,75,15). I independently reconstructed the 515 faces, pivot matching with 225 pairs, 1 critical zero-cell and 64 critical 2-cells, and verified the complete reversed-Hasse graph is acyclic on all 515 nodes. Forman implies the integral wedge of 64 two-spheres. The inspected full group-action verifier enumerates all 600 affine semilinear permutations, exact signed fixed-face traces, conjugacy classes and Fourier multiplicities, consistent with the statements; the claimed full-group character is a finite exact computation, not a consequence of Betti numbers alone.
